name: @finapp/m34-marketplace
description: M34 — Connector Marketplace (Stage 6D-2, mvp:false): the governed marketplace over the connectors m33 defines — catalog LISTINGS, tenant INSTALLATIONS, CONSENT and UPGRADES. It CONSUMES m33 (integration foundation) BY CONTRACT: a listing/installation references an m33 connector by OPAQUE id and validates availability through a fail-closed ConnectorRegistryPort — m34 does NOT duplicate m33's connector SDK/registry/runtime/connection/secret engine and never executes a connector (that is m33's responsibility). IT IS NOT A SECRETS MANAGER: install-time secret-bearing config is stored ONLY as opaque secretref: pointers (the m30 seam); ZERO credential/secret VALUE columns; real key management is deferred to m41 behind a fail-closed port. CONSENT + INSTALL + UPGRADE are CONTROLLED actions: a tenant consenting to a connector's data access (and an upgrade that widens access) is human-governed (maker-checker/SoD, AI never consents/approves, consent is revocable, default deny). A published listing is IMMUTABLE (trigger). It uses the marketplace_* table prefix (integration_* is m23's, connector_* is m33's) and owns marketplace.lifecycle ONLY (devportal/webhook/eventstream/govrelease belong to m35-m37). Reuses m02 RBAC, m03 audit, m06 OUTBOX, m30 secret-reference seam and m33 connector contracts BY CONTRACT — NO second engine (no 2nd outbox/RBAC/audit/secrets-manager/connector-runtime engine). It declares /api/v1/connectors, the marketplace.* permission namespace (GAP-4 resolved), the marketplace.lifecycle event family (published through the ONE m06 outbox) and the MARKETPLACE_ audit prefix. No secret value; no external network/provider; no arbitrary code.
